sketches.study_axis: electric-key body swelling into its hammer edge
sketches.intent: A rounded electric-key ring gathers its hard tine edge late, then closes instead of ringing out. Sparse minor voicings and isolated keys; not a piano sample or a generic slow pad. Synthesized envelope illusion, not literal audio reversal. Hold for at least 0.9 seconds; early release aborts the swell. Amplitude decay is exponential, not a hard gate. Shared Tone envelope; no note-reset LFO or automatic future note prediction.
